purpose: Measure whether the three-trunk near miss is caused by destructive task-gradient sharing among the four layers tied to each trunk.

measurement.method: load the exact terminal checkpoint, freeze all parameters, locally untie each layer's c_fc/c_proj matrices, and backpropagate one fixed effective task batch

primary_metric: combined c_fc/c_proj common-update energy fraction per contiguous layer group
decision_rule: Authorize a less-shared trunk only if the measured four-layer groups show material cancellation and the proposed smaller groups recover substantially more common-update energy. Prefer the smallest group count supported by the conflict transition; otherwise stop this branch.
